detail.longDescription: Findcheap is a search agent that finds the best price in one click. It performs >2x better than the next-best frontier model (GPT-6 Astra), albeit on a very specific task. Full benchmark results: https://findcheap.ai/introducing-findcheap It works on every product page on the internet, and is able to successfully find better deals for 94% of them. Feel free to roast!
